name: Alberta: income and sales tax, 2026
name_fr: Alberta : impôt sur le revenu et taxes de vente, 2026
description: Provincial/territorial personal income tax brackets, basic personal amount and sales tax rates for Alberta for the 2026 tax year, with estimated take-home pay for a single employee at three salaries.

sales_tax.note: No provincial or territorial retail sales tax; only the 5% GST applies. HST replaces GST and PST in participating provinces. PST/QST bases and exemptions differ from GST and are set provincially; only headline rates are recorded here.

attributes.notes: Alberta's 8% bracket on the first $61,200 applies from 2025; non-refundable credits are calculated at 8% for 2026 (T4127). Alberta supplemental credit (25% of credits above $4,896) not relevant for a single filer with only basic credits.

sources.title: Current year tax rates and income brackets (2026) — page modified 2026-06-25
T4127 Payroll Deductions Formulas, 122nd edition, effective 1 January 2026 (Table 8.1 rates and thresholds; basic personal amounts; CPP/QPP/EI/QPIP parameters)
GST/HST calculator (and rates for provinces) — rates on or after 1 April 2025; page modified 2025-04-01

verification.notes: Brackets agree between the CRA current-year page and T4127 Table 8.1 (Jan 2026, PE updated May 2026).

limitations: Headline rates only: no refundable credits, low-income reductions, dividend or capital-gains treatment, or property taxes. The net-pay figures in attributes are estimates (method in nat-ca-take-home-pay-examples-2026), not official figures.
